[EN] Secret Directive
[ES] Directriz secreta
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] For the federation!
[ES] ¡Por la federación!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Now, we're in business.
[ES] Ahora sí que estamos haciendo buenos negocios.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ignore the directive and go to Dirken.
[ES] Ignora la directriz y ve a ver a Dirken.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] See Dirken's left-hand man, Zaira, at the dock southeast of Cutthroat Harbor.
[ES] Busca a la mano derecha de Dirken, Zaira, en el muelle al sureste de Puerto Canalla.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm looking for work."
[ES] "Estoy buscando trabajo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Dirken at the dock southeast of Cutthroat Harbor.
[ES] Habla con Dirken en el muelle al sureste de Puerto Canalla.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
